purpose: Dallas final team-completion gate. Certify the 53-player realistic 3D chibi library for Gamecast only when roster identity, official-headshot appearance provenance, action coverage, animation determinism, verified signatures, compositing quality, and cross-sport isolation all remain intact under production-like live-play conditions.

rosterAndAppearance: Exactly 53 active-roster identities resolve uniquely to Dallas player namespaces and roster-authoritative action inventories.

Every personalized likeness remains gated by locked current official-headshot provenance; skin tone and visible appearance are never inferred from player name, position, number, or other roster metadata.
Displayed uniform number must match roster-authoritative identity; stale or mismatched personalized assets fail closed without substituting another player's likeness.
renderContract: Approved realistic 3D chibi proportions, camera angle, lighting, scale, canonical foot anchor, uniform orientation, and transparent background remain consistent across all reusable base/action assets.
Alpha edges remain clean at Gamecast compositing scale with no opaque box, matte halo, clipped body/equipment, floating feet, or anchor drift.
Action completion, interruption, resize, reconnect, resume, and reduced-motion paths return the player to the same canonical scale and ground anchor.
runtimeContract: Authoritative play identity and revision always supersede cached render state, stale promises, prior polling results, or an in-flight celebration.
Unchanged play polling is idempotent; an accepted event/action/signature cannot restart merely because the same live payload is observed again.
Only one football owner is authoritative at a time and ownership transfers or clears deterministically as authoritative play truth changes.
Missing, malformed, stale, late-decoding, or ineligible personalized assets degrade locally to safe Dallas fallback without blocking Gamecast or contaminating another participant.

verifiedSignatures.correction: preempt immediately if authoritative revision removes Lamb or the first down
preempt immediately if authoritative revision removes Miller or the sack

finalCertification.signaturePolicy: These are the only verified named Dallas signature concepts in the current library. Any other named player-specific signature requires source-backed verification before routing or labeling.
finalCertification.isolation: Certification is confined to sports/nfl/assets/chibis/DAL and NFL chibi metadata. MLB and NHL routes, renderers, polling, state, assets, and behavior remain unchanged.

acceptanceFixtures.expect: All identities are unique; roster actions, number locks, appearance provenance, alpha quality, camera/scale/lighting and foot anchors satisfy the production contract.

acceptanceFixtures.scenario: offense possession chain under duplicate polls
acceptanceFixtures.expect: Pass/catch/run/contact transitions execute once in authoritative order with exactly one football owner and no replay from unchanged payloads.
Participant identity and football state follow the newest authoritative revision; superseded animations terminate without stale resurrection.
Roster-authoritative action inventories route correctly and all participants preserve canonical scale, anchor and transparent compositing.
Nose-wipe is eligible only for the authoritative Lamb first down and ordinary first-down celebration remains the safe fallback.
DeSoto Shuffle is eligible only for the authoritative Miller sack and ordinary sack celebration remains the safe fallback.
Named-signature routing is rejected without inventing a player-specific concept.
Personalized asset is suppressed locally; event identity remains correct and no inferred appearance or teammate likeness is used.

acceptanceFixtures.scenario: late asset decode after play replacement plus reconnect
acceptanceFixtures.expect: Stale decode is discarded; newest play retains participant, animation, anchor and football authority.
Authoritative event decisions remain identical while presentation reprojects cleanly without anchor drift, clipping, duplicate playback or identity swap.

acceptanceFixtures.scenario: missing or malformed personalized action asset
acceptanceFixtures.expect: Failure stays player-local and action-local, falls back safely, and never blocks the Gamecast loop.
No MLB/NHL file, route, polling behavior, Gamecast state, or asset namespace is changed by Dallas certification.

completionCriteria: All 53 Dallas players satisfy roster identity, official-headshot provenance, uniform-number, action-inventory, realistic-3D render, transparent-alpha and canonical-anchor gates.
Gamecast playback remains deterministic under duplicate polls, authoritative corrections, late decoding, reconnect, resize, resume and reduced-motion paths.
CeeDee Lamb nose-wipe and Von Miller DeSoto Shuffle remain the only verified named Dallas signatures; no named signature is invented.
No MLB or NHL behavior/files are modified.
On success Dallas may be marked complete and the next team may begin roster-scaffold in a future batch.
